final: WITH got_gpt_stats AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(CAST(GOT AS REAL) - CAST(GPT AS REAL)) as avg_diff FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5 AND GOT IS NOT NULL AND GPT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CENTROMEA), aptt_pt_stats AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(CAST(APTT AS REAL) - CAST(PT AS REAL)) as avg_diff FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5 AND APTT IS NOT NULL AND PT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) FROM got_gpt_stats) as overall_got_gpt, (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) FROM aptt_pt_stats) as overall_appt_pt
